- When I called UP, the player moved LEFT

- DOWN → RIGHT
- RIGHT → UP

- Called RIGHT multiple times, player moved RIGHT
- Called DOWN, player moved DOWN
- Called LEFT, player moved DOWN (not LEFT!)
- Called UP, player moved LEFT (not UP!)
Hmm, this doesn't fit a simple rotation pattern. Let me think more carefully.
Actually, looking at the segmentation:
- Before LEFT: player at row 36-39, col 36-39
- After LEFT: player at row 40-43, col 36-39 (moved DOWN by 4)
- Before UP: player at row 40-43, col 36-39
- After UP: player at row 40-43, col 32-35 (moved LEFT by 4)
So LEFT → DOWN and UP → LEFT. This is a 90-degree clockwise rotation! So:
- UP → LEFT
- RIGHT → UP
- DOWN → RIGHT
- LEFT → DOWN
Wait, but earlier RIGHT seemed to work correctly. Let me check...
Actually, I need to be more careful. Let me look at the history of movements:
